Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Solid Ground.

Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Catalyst Elemental from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.

Cast Catalyst Elemental by paying {R} due to Semblance Anvil.
Activate Catalyst Elemental by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Catalyst Elemental dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Catalyst Elemental with haste.
Activate the Catalyst Elemental token by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.

1718-2510-4477-7182.notes: If you have at least {2}{R} in your mana pool on a particular iteration, step 10 can be skipped.

1365-1651-5359-6727--125.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, targeting Threefold Thunderhulk.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Threefold Thunderhulk and the other creature that enters with +1/+1 counter(s), untapping Kuldotha Forgemaster.
Activate Kuldotha Forgemaster by tapping it and sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk, the creature entering with +1/+1 counter(s) and another artifact.
When Threefold Thunderhulk and the other creature die, their persist abilities trigger, returning them from your graveyard to the battlefield. The -1/-1 counters placed upon them will be removed by the +1/+1 counter(s) placed on them as they enter the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Resolve the Kuldotha Forgemaster ability, searching your library for an artifact card and putting it onto the battlefield.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Gnomes, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Repeat.
1365-1651-5359-6727--125.notes: The chosen creature that enters with +1/+1 counter(s) must either enter with two or more counters or have toughness 1 or greater. You may also include an anthem effect to boost toughness.

When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2292-2906-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.
